values.meaning: delay before damage/silence lands after cast
values.quote: After {{fd|0.4}} seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt

mechanics.claim: Damage and silence are applied 0.4 seconds after cast, not instantly.
mechanics.quote: After {{fd|0.4}} seconds, enemies between the portals are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silenced}} for a duration.

mechanics.claim: The spell can be blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent ''Call of the Void's'' refresh on {{ai|Malefic Visions|Malzahar}}.
